title: Summary delete trash icon control wired to Dashboard state and fresh deploy draft guidance

requirements.summary: Add a dedicated Summary Delete trash icon button in the Summary card header that clears only the Summary text without affecting the Quiz state.
acceptanceCriteria: When a summary is displayed, the Summary card shows a trash icon button positioned in the card’s top-right corner (inside the card header area).

Clicking the trash icon clears the summary content by setting the Summary state to an empty string, and the Summary section no longer renders (since the dashboard currently only renders the Summary section when `summary` is truthy).
Clicking the Summary delete control does not change `quizArray` state; any rendered Quiz section remains visible and unchanged.
The existing Quiz delete button continues to delete only the quiz content and does not affect the Summary state.
All user-facing text remains in English.

file_operations.description: Implement the Summary Delete control UI as a trash icon button placed in the Summary card header top-right (use shadcn-ui Button styling for an icon action and lucide-react trash icon). Ensure it only triggers a provided callback and does not touch any quiz state. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Wire Summary deletion into Dashboard state via a dedicated handler and pass it to SummaryCard via props without changing Quiz deletion behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: `frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx` includes a dedicated handler that clears only the summary state (e.g., `setSummary('')`).
`frontend/src/components/SummaryCard.tsx` accepts an `onDelete` (or equivalent) callback prop and calls it when the trash icon button is clicked.
No changes are made that couple Summary deletion to Quiz deletion (e.g., Summary deletion must not call `setQuizArray([])`).

file_operations.description: Add a dedicated Summary delete handler that clears only `summary` state and pass it into SummaryCard (e.g., `onDelete`). Keep the existing quiz delete handler and QuizSection wiring unchanged.

Update props to accept an `onDelete` callback and call it from the new trash icon button; do not introduce any coupling to quiz deletion. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Update deployment guidance to ensure a fresh build draft and successful frontend build/deploy can be produced from the updated repo state.
acceptanceCriteria: A new build draft is created successfully (no “You don’t have a draft yet” deployment error).
The build passes TypeScript compilation and the frontend build step.
A fresh deployment is produced and is accessible at the generated deployment URL(s).

file_operations.description: Revise the deployment instructions to explicitly cover creating a new build draft from the current repository state and verifying the TypeScript + frontend build steps complete successfully before/after deployment (include mention of avoiding the “You don’t have a draft yet” scenario).
